assessments.summary: Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 533% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 57 cases per week this week.
Ebola cases are peaking in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with sustained high-level transmission, including imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria.
Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 232% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 223 cases per week this week.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a 1762% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 98 cases per week this week.
Influenza activity is at baseline with a 11% increase in global flu test positivity and 61% rise in US hospital admissions over the past month.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 79% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 280 cases per week this week.
Zika virus readership is at the 67th percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest.
Marburg virus disease readership is at the 69th percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest.
Malaria cases in the US are rising, with 38 reported cases per week this week compared to 23.8 weeks ago, and 1,130 cases this year versus 1,400 last year.
Mpox cases in the US are at baseline, with 41 reported cases per week this week compared to 28.1 weeks ago, and 1,434 cases this year versus 2,018 last year.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising, with 374 reported cases per week this week compared to 252 weeks ago, and 12,054 cases this year versus 29,278 last year.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline, with 6 reported cases per week this week compared to 6.5 weeks ago, and 265 cases this year versus 207 last year.
Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hospital admissions in the US are at baseline, with 870 admissions this week compared to 612 weeks ago, and global test positivity is at 1.8%.
Avian influenza (bird flu) Wikipedia readership is at the 33rd percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest.
COVID-19 hospital admissions in the US are at baseline, with 4,046 admissions this week compared to 4,353 weeks ago, and Wikipedia readership is at the 1st percentile of the past year.
